name: Mahou no Shugo Hime Artemina
original_name: 魔法の守護姫アルテミナ
source:
A mature and somewhat philosophical girl Arisa encounters Magnus, a white horse that speaks Japanese. When Magnus asks her to transform into a magical girl, Arisa, fearing the disruption of her normal life, initially flees. However, when Arisa and Magnus become targets of the evil organization Greed, she is forced to transform into the magical girl Artemina and confront the organization's attacks. As Greed threatens to disrupt the world, Arisa, now Artemina, struggles with the erosion of her everyday life. Despite facing personal challenges, Arisa develops a sense of duty as Artemina and grapples with the choice between despair and a peaceful everyday life in the face of an uncertain future.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.route2.co.jp/Trois/Products/artemina/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
成熟且略带哲思的女孩亚里沙遇见一匹会说日语的白马马格努斯。马格努斯请她变身为魔法少女，亚里沙害怕平凡生活被打乱，起初逃走了。然而，当她与马格努斯成为邪恶组织“贪婪”的目标时，她被迫变身为魔法少女阿尔忒弥娜，对抗组织的袭击。随着“贪婪”威胁扰乱世界，已成为阿尔忒弥娜的亚里沙努力抵抗日常生活被侵蚀。面对个人挑战与不确定的未来，她逐渐建立起责任感，在绝望与平静日常间艰难抉择。

[译自[url=http://www.route2.co.jp/Trois/Products/artemina/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
